articles.title: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
articles.description: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

articles.title: Poland accuses Russian military helicopter of violating its airspace
articles.description: Poland says the aircraft stayed in its skies for 42 seconds, forcing the Nato member to scramble its fighter jets.

articles.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
articles.description: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.

articles.title: A red carpet and military flyover - How Trump welcomed Xi
articles.description: The two B-1 bombers that flew overhead are a key part of the US's combat arsenal, and produce a notoriously loud roar when they pass by.

articles.title: Son of Israeli ambassador to US 'seriously injured' in West Bank ramming attack
articles.description: The son of Israel's ambassador to the US has reportedly been seriously injured in a ramming attack in the occupied West Bank.

articles.title: British businessman jailed over illegal arms deals to war zones worth millions
articles.description: A British businessman and an adviser to a quango funded by the UK government have each been jailed for 16 years after brokering illegal arms deals to send fighter jets and weapons to war zones.

articles.title: Fifteen jailed for life over involvement in Sri Lanka attacks that killed more than 260
articles.description: Fifteen men have been convicted for their involvement in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings which killed more than 260 people in Sri Lanka.
